dct_description_sm: This dataset contains raw data from the study titled "Toxicity and Behavioral Responses of Environmentally Relevant Microplastics in Earthworms (Eisenia fetida): Ingestion, Survival, Reproduction, and Avoidance Across Common Polymer Types". It includes measurements of earthworm ingestion, survival, reproduction, and avoidance responses when exposed to various common microplastic polymer types.
